test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Ranjan, Pari, Yash, Charu, Reetu and Gunjan are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Ranjan sits 3rd to the left of Pari. Yash sits 2nd to the left of Ranjan. Charu sits 2nd to the right of Ranjan. Reetu is an immediate neighbour of Charu.

Who sits 2nd to the right of Pari?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Ranjan sits 3rd to the left of Pari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa0af70d9c753a74cf7814650ac93497dd1a652bcbb09e85a411392eee82e69.png] 

2) Yash sits 2nd to the left of Ranjan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f140d74e503fe59572a36f6ff28ad0bba8b87cc2fcaa94280c95d49bea2cd2c.png] 

3) Charu sits 2nd to the right of Ranjan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2092516dcbe03e74f9e47526ec0a05cf46b39daa607e240491160fc615c478e0.png] 

4) Reetu is an immediate neighbour of Charu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96adf417665ede3def93b48930874efe37d568e7e88aa3e7447c837816bc3cdc.png] 

Here, we can see that Gunjan is sitting second to the right of Pari.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Gunjan"**.
